name: Seated Calf Raise
summary: A calf isolation exercise performed seated with the knees bent, which shifts the emphasis to the soleus muscle underneath the calf.
setup: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform with your heels hanging off.
Set the knee pad snugly over your lower thighs.
Position your feet about hip width apart and release the safety catch.
execution: Lower your heels slowly until you feel a full stretch in your calves.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Squeeze your calves at the top for a second.
Lower under control and repeat, then re-engage the safety.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom: pause for a second and keep a steady tempo.
Using a partial range: go through the full range every rep.
Rolling the ankles out: keep the load through the ball of the big toe.
Using too heavy a load: reduce the weight until you can control the full range.
